event_summary: A small gray object enters from the left, moves across the tabletop toward the center-right area, then turns back left and exits the frame.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wood tabletop holding a black object with a shiny curved handle near the right side, a yellow duck-shaped toy to its right, and a partially visible black cylindrical object at the far left edge. After a still interval, a small gray rounded object appears from the left side of the tabletop, moves rightward with visible blur, passes in front of the black handled object without visibly contacting it, then changes direction and moves back leftward until it leaves the frame at the left edge. The other visible objects remain in place.

reasons: The tabletop and stationary objects are visible before the moving gray object appears.
The black handled object and yellow duck-shaped toy are clearly visible.
The later moving gray object is not yet visible in the first frame.
